- Read fresh. A package-less write of an `email_template` at a locale the base does not ship (zh-CN beside a base that ships only en-US) answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. The prescribed `.custom` override is refused too, because the base ships no such locale. So an author cannot add a translation through either door, although `packagelessCloseSubject` documents it as open. The skills text landed with PR #29924 says the same. Measured on a live boot, so p2.
- Fix site: `metadata-protocol` (`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`). The refusal sentence is shared with #29479, so serial with it. `finding` leaves the card now that it is graded.
